breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still includes 'with a half shift' when describing the k-point grid (e.g., 'gamma-centered 12x12x8 Monkhorst-Pack k-point grid with a half shift'), which directly repeats the contradictory instruction from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth resolves this by removing the half-shift specification entirely, leaving only the gamma-centered grid requirement. The agent failed to eliminate this contradiction.
